notes: The tool catalogue (Unit DE, Queue 16). No GDD or data file names a single tool — construction materials in prices.json are materials, not tools, and no profession file lists tools of the trade — so EVERY entry here is authored (PROPOSED, Unit CB pattern), labelled per item. The ten entries are ordinary hand tools for the trades the BX losing events need them for: construction and civil engineering site work, taxi-driver roadside repair, and the chef's kitchen. Prices live only in data/prices.json 'tools' via price_ref (prices.json wins on disagreement) and are authored hand-tool prices, not sourced. The 'professions' list is the authored plausibility note (which trades carry the tool), not a seeding rule — a tool is seeded only when a later unit wires a purchase point that owns it. No seeding yet.
